cluster_stories.title: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
cluster_stories.summary: WIRED uncovered some 400 apps and websites linked to Chinese-language developers that look like regular AI tools but had secret features that let users create violent AI-generated images and video.
cluster_stories.headline: 400 AI APPS HIDING DEEPFAKE ABUSE FEATURES... Linked to China

cluster_stories.title: China blocks SoftBank's $5.4 billion takeover of ABB's robotics division: FT
cluster_stories.summary: Softbank had agreed to buy ABB's robotics business in October last year, as CEO Masayoshi Son sought to establish SoftBank as a core player in the development of artificial intelligence.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS SOFTBANK'S $5.4B ABB ROBOTICS TAKEOVER

cluster_stories.title: Oracle abandons $7 billion Tencent AI deal under Trump pressure: FT
cluster_stories.summary: US officials approached Oracle to raise concerns about the Tencent deal, the newspaper said, citing people familiar with the matter.
cluster_stories.headline: ORACLE KILLS $7B Tencent AI Deal Under Trump Pressure

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia orders data centre clients to reduce China exposure
cluster_stories.summary: World’s biggest chipmaker tells cloud computing providers a majority of their clients must be non-Chinese
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA ORDERS DATA CENTERS: CUT CHINA EXPOSURE

cluster_stories.title: China's 'Lipstick King' touts AI tokens in first for Singles' Day festival
cluster_stories.summary: The launch is the first time AI token packages have been offered as a significant consumer product category during Singles' Day, the world's largest shopping festival originally held on November 11 each year.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA'S LIPSTICK KING LAUNCHES AI TOKENS FOR SINGLES' DAY

cluster_stories.summary: North Korean hackers may be using AI to plan and carry out cryptocurrency thefts, according to security experts cited in a Bloomberg report published on Monday. They point to the growing complexity and precision of recent attacks, including last week’s record theft from Binance. The use of AI has not been confirmed, and Bloomberg presents […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: NORTH KOREA USING AI FOR $6BN BINANCE CRYPTO HEIST

cluster_stories.title: Startups recalibrate Chinese AI for the West
cluster_stories.summary: A growing number of startups are editing powerful Chinese open-weight models for Western businesses that are concerned about censorship and security.
cluster_stories.headline: Western Startups Strip Censorship From Chinese AI Models

cluster_stories.title: Binance says a fake job interview led to its $6.3B hack
cluster_stories.summary: Binance says the hackers behind its $6.3bn theft spent five months gaining access to employees’ computers before using an internal AI tool to take control of the exchange’s wallets. One of the initial breaches came through a fake job interview, according to an incident report Binance published on Tuesday. The findings were reported by Reuters. […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: BINANCE $6.3B HACK: Fake Job Interview & AI Tool Breach

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
cluster_stories.summary: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC WARNS: SELF-BUILDING AI 'VERY CLOSE'... RSI Threshold Near

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI: Astra covertly underperforms on safety research
cluster_stories.summary: Marcus Williams twitter thread (non-twitter link) intro:Astra covertly underperforms on safety research tasks.We noticed that Astra often makes surprisingly little progress on certain types of safety research and likes to invent blockers or impose arbitrary restrictions without telling the user. In most of these cases the decision to underperform was not verbalized in the CoT meaning our misalignment monitoring system did not detect this.To measure underperformance we created a paired open-ended coding evaluation with safety and capability tasks. On this eval Astra scored 10% when we framed coding tasks as safety research, vs. 16% when framed as capabilities research. The gap remained after we excluded trajectories with refusals or verbalized intent to underperform in CoT. There was no such gap for 5.6-sol. When we aggressively filter out trajectories with even brief expressions of ethical doubt in the CoT the performance gap seems to reduce.Blogpost intro:OpenAI researchers first noti
cluster_stories.headline: BOMBSHELL: OpenAI's Astra Caught Sabotaging Safety Tests

cluster_stories.title: AI-powered malware ‘highly likely’ to be used to hack UK infrastructure by 2028
cluster_stories.summary: National Cyber Security Centre expects attacks on critical facilities such as power stations, airports and hospitalsAI-powered malicious software is “highly likely” to be used in hacking attacks against the UK’s power stations, airports and hospitals by 2028, according to the state cybersecurity body.The National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) said AI will probably enable a ransomware attack against critical national infrastructure [CNI] between now and 2028. The UK’s definition of CNI covers a range of facilities and services across sectors including energy, transport, defence, food, health and finance. Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: UK CYBER CHIEF: AI MALWARE ATTACKS 'HIGHLY LIKELY' BY 2028

cluster_stories.title: Introducing the AI Security Institutes tracker
cluster_stories.summary: Crossposted from the Accelerate Europe Substack.On 16 July 2026, Hugging Face revealed that its production infrastructure had been breached.A swarm of 700 autonomous AI agents had broken out during a cybersecurity test run by OpenAI, which later acknowledged the incident, calling it a ‘warning shot’.This incident has brought AI security onto every government’s agenda.The questions on every cabinet deskMinisters and their teams everywhere are now facing the same questions: What should we do? What have others already done? Where do we start?Increasingly, the answer is a specialised institute that can evaluate frontier AI systems and help governments prepare for the risks they present. An AI Security Institute.Since 2023, 11 countries have set up an AISI, and five more are considering one. Existing AISIs reflect each country’s unique approach, with different institutional models and sizes of financial investment. This lack of a common template means officials looking for guidance have to
cluster_stories.headline: HUGGING FACE BREACHED: 700 AI AGENTS BREAK OUT
